objective: Design and implement the Blessing System including data, editor importer, runtime manager, evolution mechanics, and tests.

steps.title: Analyze Schema
steps.description: Review blessings.schema.json and enumerate required fields, enums, and evolution model.

steps.title: Author Data Models
steps.description: Create POCOs and ScriptableObject definitions mirroring schema under Assets/Scripts/DataModels/.

steps.title: Create ScriptableObjects
steps.description: Implement BlessingDefinition ScriptableObject with CreateAssetMenu attribute.

steps.title: Editor Importer
steps.description: Add JSON importer that validates against schema and creates ScriptableObjects.

steps.title: Runtime Manager
steps.description: Implement BlessingManager to handle acquisition, evaluation, and application of blessings.

steps.title: Evolution Mechanics
steps.description: Implement deterministic triggers and stage progression for blessings.

steps.title: Integrate & Test
steps.description: Integrate with Combat and Card systems; add unit and schema compliance tests.

notes: Follow project conventions for namespaces and folders.
Use relative paths and reference Assets/docs/schemas/blessings.schema.json for data constraints.
